title: Add index on contacts(changed_at_counter) — gap from V11
description: V11 migration added idx_chats_changed_at_counter on chats(changed_at_counter) to accelerate Chat/changes queries. The equivalent index on contacts(changed_at_counter) was not added. The query in ContactStore.get_changes_since_ordered() — WHERE changed_at_counter > ?1 ORDER BY changed_at_counter ASC — does a full table scan of contacts on every ChatContact/changes call. For Phase 1 with few contacts this is negligible, but it is inconsistent with the chats optimization and will hurt at scale. Fix: add V12 migration: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_contacts_changed_at_counter ON contacts(changed_at_counter).
